purpose: One paid 5-second proof before any batch generation.
scene_selection: proposal; the user/ChatGPT confirm which scene is tested

scene.visual_description: Wide establishing shot of a cozy small Japanese apartment kitchen in morning sunlight, young adult Japanese man with tousled dark hair and a plain white T-shirt.
scene.motion: Subtle physically plausible movement of the described action; no new actions; no implied cut
scene.continuity: Same protagonist, plain white T-shirt, apartment kitchen and cookware; preserve ingredient state, hand anatomy and lighting across neighboring shots.

params.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a cozy small Japanese apartment kitchen in morning sunlight, young adult Japanese man with tousled dark hair and a plain white T-shirt. Warm hand-drawn semi-realistic anime food illustration, ink outlines, subtle watercolor/marker shading, cinematic framing. A single consistent young Japanese man in his twenties with tousled black hair wearing a plain white T-shirt, the same cozy compact apartment kitchen with wooden countertops, warm daylight and consistent utensils. Chicken nanban cooked from raw chicken thigh through egg batter frying, sweet-sour nanban sauce, egg-onion tartar sauce, plating and tasting. Vertical 9:16. No captions, no watermarks. Maintain continuity with the attached storyboard reference panel.

cost.basis: Read-only Higgsfield preflight 2026-10-12: seedance_2_5, 5s, 9:16, 720p, omni_reference, generate_audio false = 35 credits (docs/seedance-test-plan.md). Estimate only; re-quote with the uploaded reference before submitting.

edit_use.trim: window chosen at review (trim_in_seconds); default start of clip

review_checklist: framing, subject and action match the storyboard panel
hand anatomy (finger count, grip, no merging with utensils)
food state matches the step (raw vs cooked, batter, sauce)
